description: This file defines the SimpleAnnotationReader class, which is a custom implementation for reading annotations in Drupal, based on Doctrine's SimpleAnnotationReader. It manages annotation parsing, ignoring common annotations, and provides methods to retrieve annotations for classes, methods, and properties.

classes.name: SimpleAnnotationReader
classes.description: A final class that provides methods to parse and retrieve annotations from PHP classes, methods, and properties, with Drupal-specific customizations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of SimpleAnnotationReader, setting up the DocParser with specific ignore settings.

methods.name: addNamespace
methods.description: Adds a namespace to the parser for annotation lookup.

methods.name: getClassAnnotations
methods.description: Retrieves annotations applied to a given class.

methods.name: getMethodAnnotations
methods.description: Retrieves annotations applied to a given method.

methods.name: getPropertyAnnotations
methods.description: Retrieves annotations applied to a given property.

methods.name: getClassAnnotation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific annotation instance from a class.

methods.name: getMethodAnnotation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific annotation instance from a method.

methods.name: getPropertyAnnotation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific annotation instance from a property.
